title: Extend plane pattern scale range

request.text: дай возможность еще больше уменьшать скейл

decision: Lower the Pattern scale minimum from 0.5 to 0.1 while preserving the 0.5 default and derivative antialiasing.
result: Pattern scale now reaches 0.1 while the default remains 0.5. Focused unit, protected browser/WebGL frequency coverage, and embedded visual inspection passed; the app was restored to scale 0.5 and zoom 60%.
risks: Very small pattern features may antialias into a flat tone, so the lower endpoint must retain balanced ink and higher transition frequency.
